scope: Re-key existing seven clips and add deterministic Babylon pose sampling; no new bones, clips, or runtime framework.

gameplayCameraTopThree: Melee and ranged clips now expose explicit wind-up/aim, impact/fire, recoil, and recovery timeline points.
Foot, pelvis, chest, head, and arm channels are sampled together so combat poses are not represented by a single arm frame.
The compact carbine remains visually dominant in some side-on aim views and needs human shape/pose judgment.
closeUpTopThree: Melee impact has a held silhouette and supported stance rather than an instantaneous single-arm rotation.
Ranged aim keeps both arm chains engaged and adds small root/foot counterbalance keys.
The rounded authored volumes and flat carbine profile are still visible in clay; this evidence does not claim commercial quality.
remainingProceduralFeel: Helmet and limb rings remain readable in close-up.
The carbine still reads as a broad profile in selected camera angles.

humanDecision: Not a commercial-quality pass. Runtime and pose evidence are ready for the final bounded gameplay capture and human art decision.
